task_name: Fix round 3: catalog error after a quiet re-read, and test strength of fix round 2 (F-001 to F-005)
description: F-001: the explorer's error state now records whether a catalog read or a rebuild failed; a quiet re-read that succeeds removes a failed catalog read's banner and leaves a rebuild's. F-002 to F-005: tests that pin a partly empty relationship list, a second-step row in the Wiki disclosure count, the retirement of a pending wiki-link lookup and page of results by a rebuild's reload, and MetaprojectWork's hidden wrapper, callbacks and lazy default explorer.

acceptance_criteria_met: all of the task's finish lines; AC19's whole-suite run (bun test src) was not run here, only the four named files

noticed_not_touched.what: The two `project.current++` bumps (catalog effect body when not quiet, and its cleanup when the next run is not quiet) fire together on every non-quiet re-run, so each alone is redundant (R3-19 and R3-20 cannot be killed one at a time). A follow-up could keep one bump and state which event it stands for.

If a change of the read function (protocol or request prop) lands in the same commit as a return to the view, the visible effect sets quietRead before the catalog effect body runs, so that read runs quiet (no error clear, no start bump); the setRevision it queued then runs a second, loud read. Two catalog reads for one return; only reachable when props change during the return.

assumptions: A rebuild that the user starts still clears whatever banner stands (catalog or rebuild), as before this task; the new test pins that rather than changing it.

behavior_changes.description: After a catalog read the user started fails (Retry, Refresh catalog, or the reload after a rebuild) and the user leaves the Metaproject view and returns once the catalog can be read, the failure banner with Retry is gone, whether the snapshot changed or not. A failed rebuild's banner still stays after such a return, and a quiet re-read that fails still shows and removes nothing.
alternatives: Keep every standing banner across a quiet re-read (round 2's behaviour, the defect F-001 names).
Clear every banner, the rebuild's included, on a successful quiet re-read (contradicts the existing rebuild test and the finish line).

not_touched.reason: F-005 is a test gap; MetaprojectWork already passes visible, onRebuild, onDraft and the lazy default, and the new App.dom tests pin them. R3-13 (the ProjectWindow call site) rests on the live check.

F-001 banner table (one `error` state, now {source: "catalog" | "rebuild", message} | null; MetaprojectView.tsx:318).
Writers at head after this change: catalog effect start, not quiet -> null (:380); catalog effect catch, latest read and not quiet -> {catalog} (:407); quiet success -> clear only a {catalog} error (:392, new); rebuild() start -> null (:677); rebuild() catch -> {rebuild} (:681). Standing banner x following event -> banner after (test that pins it):
- failed first read x return: no quiet read starts (loaded is false), banner stays (existing 'a return after a failed first catalog read starts no read...').
- failed Retry/Refresh/post-rebuild reload x quiet re-read succeeds, same snapshot: banner GOES (new, was: stays) ('a quiet re-read that succeeds after a failed catalog reload removes its banner...').
- same x quiet re-read succeeds, changed snapshot: banner GOES, new catalog shown (same new test, Retry path).
- same x quiet re-read fails: banner stays with its own message, the quiet failure is not shown (same new test).
- same x loud read succeeds: cleared at the read's start, as before (existing 'a return after a failed first catalog read...' Retry step).
- same x successful rebuild: cleared at the rebuild's start, as before; a rebuild that reloads nothing leaves it gone (new 'a rebuild the user starts removes a failed catalog read's banner...').
- failed rebuild x quiet re-read succeeds (either snapshot): stays (existing 'a standing error, such as a failed rebuild's, survives a quiet re-read on return'; the clear sits before the snapshot branch, so both branches share it).
- failed rebuild x quiet re-read fails: stays (same code path as the catalog row above).
- failed rebuild x loud read that was already in flight then succeeds: stays, as before (new 'a failed rebuild's message outlives a catalog read that was already in flight and then succeeds').
- failed rebuild x loud read started after it, or a new rebuild: cleared at start, as before ('after a quiet re-read on return, a rebuild's failed catalog reload is still shown').
Why this form: the reviewer's suggested_fix (record the source) was followed, as a field on the state rather than a separate ref, so the source cannot drift from the message; the clear is a functional update so it reads the error standing when the read lands, and it runs before the unchanged/changed-snapshot branch so both success branches share one site. Only quiet reads get it, so a loud read behaves exactly as before (mutant T24-10 shows a loud success that cleared everything would be caught).
Who else reads what changed: `error` is read only by the banner; `setError` is called only by the catalog effect and rebuild(). The comment on quietRead and the one on `error` were updated.
